text:
Hi guys,

I just wanted to talk about my quad, I built a MHQ2 quad by hovership ( http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:511668 ) which I printed myself then assembled. At first I had no camera or FPV, however now after flying it for a couple of weeks, I invested in a simple FPV system and a cheap GoPro equivelent (the SJ4000). This has really helped my flying, and the SJ4000 is great quality and has produced some absolutely epic footage. I have started to get into the more racing side of things now though, and want to go faster ( as many pilots do). So, as I have come to realise that the MHQ2 really isn't meant for speed, I was thinking about getting a new carbon fibre frame. I had in mind the QAV 180 , 210 or 250. I really have no idea which is better and if my current 3S system with 2300kv motors will work on those slightly smaller frames. If anyone could help me out, that would be great. Also, if you want to look at the videos on my channel and see what you make of them, that would be much appreciated. (leave a like and sub if you enjoy them). 

Thank you and I hope someone can help me out. :)
